title: Comptroller and Auditor-General of India or Any Other Person Appointed by Him

content.scenario: The Comptroller and Auditor-General of India has appointed a person to assist in the audit of the Central Authority's accounts. This person demands the production of books and accounts from the Central Authority.
content.outcome: The Comptroller and Auditor-General of India or any other person appointed by him in connection with the audit of the accounts of the Central Authority shall have the same rights, privileges, and authority as the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India generally has in connection with the audit of Government accounts. This includes the right to demand the production of books, accounts, connected vouchers, and other documents and papers.

user_queries: What rights and privileges does the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India or any other person appointed by him have in connection with the audit?
Can the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India appoint someone to assist in the audit?
What documents can the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India or any other person appointed by him demand from the Central Authority?
